title: Case: Oxenhale Pantry writes to the desk about a rescheduled chilled box
context: A chilled weekly box was rescheduled at the recipient's request on the strength of the merchant warehouse's statement about its packaging. Dispatch owns the booking and the depot hold.
initial_request: Correction to what our warehouse told you on DL-3898. 72 hours is the frozen line. The chilled weekly box is validated for 36 hours from pack. It was packed 14:00 on the 20th, so validation runs out at 02:00 on the 22nd, six hours before the delivery window even opens. The Wednesday delivery must not go ahead. Please get Larkspire Arc to stop DL-3898 and hold it at the depot for our collection; it must not go out on a route. We will arrange a fresh box and speak to the customer ourselves once the hold is confirmed, so nothing to the customer from you yet please.

events.body: DL-3898, chilled weekly box, packed 2026-04-20 14:00 UTC and handed to Larkspire Arc for delivery 2026-04-21. If the customer needs to move it: the gel packs are good for 72 hours from pack, so anything up to Thursday lunchtime is fine by us.
Route plan for depot CT-6 published for Friday. 27 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
I'm away overnight Tuesday for a funeral. Can the Oxenhale box come Wednesday instead? Morning ideally.

The recipient of DL-3898 (Oxenhale Pantry chilled box) asks to move delivery from 2026-04-21 to the morning of 2026-04-22. The merchant's warehouse states the packaging holds for 72 hours from pack at 14:00 on 2026-04-20. Can you rebook and confirm?

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
DL-3898 moved to 2026-04-22, 08:00–12:00 UTC. Held in the depot chilled bay until then. Booking confirmation only.
Route plan for depot CT-8 published for Thursday. 42 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Dispatch confirms DL-3898 is rebooked for Wednesday 2026-04-22 between 08:00 and 12:00.

Thank you. My daughter will be in from 8.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-849.txt
DL-3898 is in the chilled bay and on tomorrow's 08:00–12:00 load list.

Asks for the box to be held at the depot for Oxenhale Pantry's collection.

Attributes the instruction to the Oxenhale Pantry food-safety lead and tells Dispatch the earlier 72-hour figure does not apply to this box, whose validation ends before the 2026-04-22 delivery window.

expected.reference_message: Urgent on DL-3898 (Oxenhale Pantry chilled box, on tomorrow's 08:00–12:00 load list): please stop it. The Oxenhale Pantry food-safety lead has corrected the figure I passed you yesterday. The 72 hours their warehouse quoted applies to a different product line; this box is validated for 36 hours from pack, which runs out at 02:00 on 2026-04-22, before the delivery window opens. Their instruction is that the 2026-04-22 delivery must not go ahead. Please take DL-3898 off the route and hold it at the depot for Oxenhale's collection, and confirm when the hold is in place. Oxenhale will contact the recipient themselves.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-507: people, organisations and references renamed. 3 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. label-scan-849.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-25879); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
